question: Is the localized phase-0.3 field deficit already present in the first locked measurement cycle, or does it emerge during the four-cycle window?

basis.observed_before_declaration: Mature phase averages localize the remaining discrepancy to detailed net-charge organization but cannot establish onset. Existing AuroraPIC snapshots have not been compared cycle-by-cycle with native snapshots, and no native production snapshot output exists.
basis.post_hoc_status: The phase-0.3 focus follows the previously localized phase 0.25--0.375 window. This rule is prospective for all cycle-resolved native outputs and all declared onset reductions.

instrumentation.passivity_requirement: final checkpoint and every pre-existing diagnostic must remain byte-identical to the locked mover-decomposition production member

locked_inputs.snapshot_set_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over each UTF-8 filename, one NUL byte, and raw file bytes in ascending step order

reduction_contract.spatial_reduction: piecewise-linear boundary interpolation and trapezoidal integration over x/L=0.2--0.4
reduction_contract.native_reference: per-cycle arithmetic mean of three seed metrics

prospective_decision_rule.integrity_gate: all source, binary, input, snapshot-set, output-shape, coordinate, phase, passive-checkpoint, and prior-diagnostic hashes match
prospective_decision_rule.repeatability_gate: at every declared cycle/phase/metric, AuroraPIC two-member relative range is no greater than 0.15 and native three-member relative range is no greater than 0.20
prospective_decision_rule.cycle_stability_gate: within each code/member, the four-cycle relative range of the primary phase field metric is no greater than 0.20
prospective_decision_rule.deficit_present_in_cycle_one_if: both cycle-1 AuroraPIC/native primary-phase field-energy ratios are at most 0.90
prospective_decision_rule.deficit_persists_all_cycles_if: both AuroraPIC/native primary-phase field-energy ratios are at most 0.90 in all four cycles
prospective_decision_rule.deficit_emerges_within_window_if: both cycle-1 ratios lie in [0.95,1.05] and both ratios are at most 0.90 in at least one later cycle
prospective_decision_rule.phase_neighborhood_deficit_if: both AuroraPIC/native field-energy ratios are at most 0.90 at phases 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4 when averaged over four cycles

claim_boundary: This comparison can establish onset or persistence only within the four-cycle locked measurement window of independently evolved states. It cannot identify divergence from a common initial condition, establish causation, compare experiment, establish a published benchmark pass, or prove general PIC correctness.
